method: Source inner-lip aperture (InsightFace buffalo_l 106-point indices 62/60 over face-box height, comfy_nodes/gaiavfx/metrics.py mouth_aperture) per delivered frame of each Tears of Steel recast-trial window. 'evidence' is read from the trial's face-check reports (source evidence downscaled to at most 896x512); 'native' is measured on native frames by the same functions, the face chosen by the performer mask (choose_face).
observation: Assistant contact-sheet check, 9 Oct: on close-ups (faces 400-760 px) the native and evidence series agree within about 0.001 and an aperture at most 0.004 marks visibly sealed lips (056 throughout, 058 w0 frames 29-47, 061 w1 frames 35-53, 059 throughout); speech reads 0.005-0.07. Faces near 100 px (006, 053) sit on a 0.003-0.012 noise floor, so they are unmeasured below 120 px. Runs of at least 12 frames (0.5 s) skip the brief closures between words.
